title: Measure bounded inventory coverage with exact owners
preconditions: Use TestInventoryCoverage fixture: app/store.go has 60 lines, app/changed.go 10, binary logo; store owns 14-40, System interaction owns 30-50, changed.go evidence is stale, lib reference is out of scope, retired and conflicted owners exist.

steps.action: Measure app scope at the explicit head commit.
steps.expected_result: 70 text lines produce 37 unique covered, 33 uncovered and 11 overlapping; two text files and one binary are distinguished.

steps.action: Inspect app/store.go overlap range 30-40 and separate health collections.
steps.expected_result: The overlap keeps two owners including system:flags#read; stale, outside-scope, unresolved and retired evidence remain separate.

steps.action: Query inventory-coverage --path app --head the full commit and page all ranges.
steps.expected_result: The public report names that head and scope; every covered range names its owners and every uncovered range has an exact source location.

expected_result: The public report names that head and scope; every covered range names its owners and every uncovered range has an exact source location.
